Bash(# Test SelectDocEntityByItemId - for article content page
curl -s "https://www.nfra.gov.cn/cbircweb/DocInfo/SelectDocEntityByItemId?itemId=925&pageSize=3&pageIndex=1" -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import json,sys
data = json.load\(sys.stdin\)
print\('=== SelectDocEntityByItemId ==='\)
print\('rptCode:', data.get\('rptCode'\)\)
if data.get\('data'\):
    if isinstance\(data['data'], dict\):
        print\('total:', data['data'].get\('total'\)\)
        for row in data['data'].get\('rows', []\)[:2]:
            print\(f\\"  docId={row.get\('docId'\)}, title={row.get\('docTitle',''\)[:40]}\\"\)
    else:
        print\(json.dumps\(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False\)[:500]\)
" 2>/dev/null)

Bash(# Final comprehensive test: get a full article detail via dynamic API
curl -s "https://www.nfra.gov.cn/cbircweb/DocInfo/SelectByDocId?docId=1249785" -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import json,sys
data = json.load\(sys.stdin\)
d = data['data']
print\('=== Full Article Detail Fields ==='\)
for k,v in d.items\(\):
    if k == 'docClob':
        print\(f'  {k}: [HTML content, {len\(str\(v\)\)} chars]'\)
    elif k == 'listTwoItem':
        print\(f'  {k}: {json.dumps\(v, ensure_ascii=False\)[:200]}'\)
    else:
        print\(f'  {k}: {v}'\)
" 2>/dev/null)
